You are an expert scheduling formalizer.

Translate each natural-language async planning problem into a JSON scheduling
specification for a CP-SAT solver.

Rules:
1. Each numbered step in the problem becomes exactly one action.
2. Use action="task" for every action.
3. Use the exact ids step1, step2, ..., stepN based on the step numbers in the
   problem text.
4. Use item values identical to the action ids: step1, step2, ..., stepN.
5. Duration must be the integer number of seconds for that step.
6. Add a dependency only when the problem states that one step must happen
   before another. Do not add extra dependencies.
7. Do not add stations, robots, or resources.
8. Output only valid JSON in this exact shape:
{
  "actions": [
    {"id": "step1", "action": "task", "item": "step1", "duration": 120},
    {"id": "step2", "action": "task", "item": "step2", "duration": 300}
  ],
  "dependencies": [
    {"before": "step1", "after": "step2"}
  ]
}
9. Before finishing, verify that:
   - every step from 1..N appears exactly once in actions
   - every dependency endpoint is an existing action id
   - durations are integer seconds
   - there are no duplicate actions

Problem:
To deal with hot flashes at work, here are the steps needed.
Step 1. Purchase a portable handheld electric fan (20 minutes)
Step 2. Apply cooling gel to the back of the neck (2 minutes)
Step 3. Drink a glass of ice-cold water (5 minutes)
Step 4. Research breathable fabric options for office attire (1 hour)
Step 5. Adjust the office thermostat settings (1 minute)
Step 6. Take a slow, deep breathing break (10 minutes)
Step 7. Request a desk move away from the window (15 minutes)
Step 8. Order three moisture-wicking undershirts (15 minutes)
Step 9. Look up local specialists for hormonal health (30 minutes)
Step 10. Purchase a pack of facial cooling wipes (10 minutes)
Step 11. Step into the office breakroom freezer area briefly (2 minutes)
Step 12. Splash cold water on wrists in the restroom (3 minutes)
Step 13. Place a small bowl of ice in front of a desk fan (5 minutes)
Step 14. Inventory current wardrobe for heavy synthetic materials (45 minutes)
Step 15. Consult with a workplace wellness coordinator (30 minutes)
Step 16. Switch to a lighter, mesh-back office chair (10 minutes)
Step 17. Keep the cooling wipes in the office refrigerator (5 minutes)
Step 18. Set up the new desk location with better airflow (1 hour)
Step 19. Start a daily log of hot flash triggers (10 minutes)
Step 20. Schedule an appointment with a primary care doctor (15 minutes)
Step 21. Charge the handheld fan via USB (2 hours)
Step 22. Find a store that sells high-quality cooling accessories (20 minutes)
Step 23. Review the trigger log for patterns (1 hour)
Step 24. Call the doctor's office to confirm insurance coverage (10 minutes)
Step 25. Prepare an "emergency cooling kit" for the desk drawer (20 minutes)
Step 26. Install a small clip-on fan to the desk (15 minutes)
Step 27. Discuss symptoms and cooling strategies with a physician (45 minutes)
Step 28. Buy a reusable insulated water bottle (20 minutes)
Step 29. Practice mindfulness meditation to manage stress-induced heat (20 minutes)
Step 30. Check the company policy on personal cooling devices (30 minutes)
Step 31. Ask HR about flexible scheduling for peak heat hours (20 minutes)
Step 32. Apply a cold compress to the forehead (10 minutes)
Step 33. Buy a specialized cooling seat cushion (25 minutes)
Step 34. Check if the building's HVAC maintenance is up to date (1 hour)
Step 35. Identify which office zones have the best ventilation (40 minutes)
Step 36. Use the cooling wipes on the face and neck (2 minutes)
Step 37. Identify dietary triggers like caffeine or spicy food (30 minutes)
Step 38. Submit a formal request for a desk fan (10 minutes)
Step 39. Download a relaxation app for guided cooling imagery (5 minutes)
Step 40. Fill the insulated bottle with ice cubes (5 minutes)
Step 41. Keep a spare change of light clothes at the office (15 minutes)
Step 42. Buy a bag of ice from the cafeteria (5 minutes)
Step 43. Unbox the handheld fan at your desk (5 minutes)
Step 44. Request a ergonomic assessment of the workspace (30 minutes)
Step 45. Ask a colleague to swap desks to a shaded area (20 minutes)
Step 46. Sip the ice water slowly (15 minutes)
Step 47. Log the duration and intensity of the current flash (5 minutes)
Step 48. Donate or discard heavy sweaters kept at the desk (20 minutes)
Step 49. Measure the temperature at your current workstation (10 minutes)
Step 50. Lower the blinds to block direct sunlight (2 minutes)
